component.name: Spola
component.summary: Keep your folders in sync with Koofr
Sincronizza le tue cartelle con Koofr

description.p: Spola keeps folders on your computer and folders on Koofr identical, in both directions, in the background. It is built on rclone's two-way sync and puts the safety of your files first.

Spola mantiene identiche, in entrambe le direzioni e in background, le cartelle del tuo computer e quelle su Koofr. Usa la sincronizzazione a due vie di rclone e mette al primo posto la sicurezza dei tuoi file.

ul.li: A preview of the first alignment before anything happens
Un'anteprima del primo allineamento prima che succeda qualsiasi cosa
Stops and asks before deleting many files at once
Si ferma e chiede prima di eliminare molti file insieme
Files changed on both sides: both versions are kept
File cambiati da entrambe le parti: restano entrambe le versioni
Replaced and deleted files are kept in a local backup for 30 days
I file sostituiti ed eliminati restano in un backup locale per 30 giorni
Add a folder by browsing your Koofr folders, with suggestions
Aggiungi una cartella sfogliando quelle su Koofr, con dei suggerimenti
Sync status and a Koofr menu in Files, Nemo, Caja and Dolphin; the Koofr menu in Thunar
Stato della sincronizzazione e menu Koofr in File, Nemo, Caja e Dolphin; il menu Koofr in Thunar
Status icon in the tray, notifications only when something needs you
Icona di stato nel tray, notifiche solo quando serve

description.p: Spola is not affiliated with Koofr.
Spola non è affiliata a Koofr.

In cima cosa sta succedendo, i file in sincronizzazione, poi le tue cartelle, raggruppate per dove si trovano
A folder's page: status, both locations, pause, exclusions
La pagina di una cartella: stato, le due posizioni, pausa, esclusioni
Adding a folder: the matching Koofr folder is suggested
Aggiungere una cartella: la cartella di Koofr corrispondente viene suggerita

I conflitti: entrambe le versioni, una scelta per ciascuno
Resolving all conflicts with one rule
Tutti i conflitti risolti con una regola

Lo stato di ogni file in File

description.p: Fixed: when many files changed only in their dates (put back from a backup, restored from Koofr's trash), a sync stopped half way could leave some of them missing on Koofr for a while. Koofr cannot change a file's date, and the copy on Koofr was deleted well before its new upload; now it is replaced only when its upload starts. Nothing was ever deleted on this computer, but another computer syncing the same folder could have deleted its copies.

Spola for Windows, a first version: an installer and a portable zip with this release, the status in the notification area and in File Explorer, Koofr's links from File Explorer, updates from the releases. Folders can now be taken over from Koofr Desktop in the window, on Linux and on Windows.

Restore from Koofr's trash, on a folder's page: what was deleted on Koofr in that folder, grouped by when, and the deletion you choose comes back, never the whole trash. Spola makes again the folders left empty, which the trash does not keep, and, since Koofr gives restored files today's date, uploads again the files identical to this computer's to put their dates back.

Fixed: a folder or a file renamed here by case alone ("Screencasts" to "screencasts") was not renamed on Koofr, which does not tell the two names apart. The preview counted its files as deleted on Koofr and uploaded again, and after the sync the files moved into it came back here in a second folder with the old name, and the folder stopped for a repair. Nothing was lost, but now Spola renames it on Koofr first, on the server, and the preview shows it as one move.

A confirmation no longer looks lost: a folder you confirm while another one syncs says at once "Confirmed, starts after the sync in progress", and the confirmed runs go in the order you gave them, before every automatic one. A preview left running in the background shows in the banner while it is prepared, then says it is ready, with the button to look at it.
When little space is left on Koofr, under 10%, the banner says how much remains.

A sync no longer looks stuck once its copies are done: when it goes on deleting files on Koofr, one at a time, the status says "Deleting: 2,000 of 8,148" and the bar moves again, then "Removing empty folders" while the folders left empty go. In the list of files, deleted folders are marked done as they go.

Fixed: after a big reorganisation, the preview counted thousands of conflicts that do not exist. rclone warns about every file new or changed on both sides, then finds most of them identical, or sees a folder made on both sides; only a file whose two copies it renames is a conflict, and only those are counted now, in the preview, in the files list and in the notifications.
Fixed: some Koofr paths kept a prefix like "koofr{kFw_7}:", so the moves of a reorganisation were also counted as uploads and deletions, and the lists showed full remote paths.

Fixed: a click on "Open Spola" in the tray menu could quit Spola. The menu's items were numbered by their place, and the place changes while a sync runs (a file done, the progress line gone): a tray that still showed the menu of a moment before sent the number that had become "Quit". Every item that does something now keeps its number wherever it moves, and a number is never given to another item.

Previews no longer hold anything up: they run next to the syncs of the other folders, the window stays usable, and you can close one and open it again at once, or cancel it for good. While it runs you see how far it is; when it is done it says how much goes each way and warns when Koofr has no room for it. A folder waiting for you has its preview prepared ahead (not on a metered connection), so Review opens it at once, and its row already says what it will do.

What waits for you is now in a banner under the header bar, and the status at the top keeps saying what Spola is doing: a folder waiting for its alignment no longer hides the others syncing. Large previews no longer freeze the window for a moment while rclone reports thousands of files.

A move stays a move: a file renamed or moved to another folder on one side is moved the same way on the other, on Koofr's server, instead of being deleted and copied again. A big reorganisation still stops for a confirmation, and its preview lists the moves as moves, not as deletions. Fixed along the way: after a file was renamed on Koofr, the next sync uploaded it again, because Koofr keeps modification times to the millisecond.

Many conflicts at once: Resolve All keeps the newer version, this computer's, Koofr's or both, after showing what happens to each file and leaving to you what the rule cannot decide. A rule can also resolve new conflicts on its own after each sync, for all folders in Preferences or for one folder on its page; the default is still to ask. The version not kept goes to the wastebasket here and to Koofr's trash.

Spola suggests names Koofr accepts for the files it refuses (the emoji taken out, "Contract (2).odt" for a name that differs only in case) and renames them once you confirm, from the list of files not synced or from the preview of a first alignment. A click on a file in a preview shows it in the file manager, or its folder on Koofr when it is only there.

Spola no longer syncs while Koofr Desktop runs on the same computer or is set to start at login: on one laptop the two engines on the same folders deleted a file on Koofr. Koofr Desktop on your other computers is fine.

Under the status at the top of the window, the files being synced, each with what is happening to it (download, upload, deletion on either side, conflict) and its progress. The tray icon shows the progress when you hover it and at the top of its menu. A sync started on its own stops when the network becomes metered, if Spola pauses there, and starts again when it no longer is. Align and Review no longer leave the window frozen for a few seconds on large folders, and the Flatpak follows the GTK 4 colours set by the desktop (Noctalia, for one).

Spola now works with the other common file managers: emblems and the Koofr menu in Nemo and Caja too, the Koofr menu in Dolphin and Thunar, and the overlay icons in Dolphin with a small plugin you build on your system. In Dolphin and Thunar the share link is shown by Spola with a Copy button. The emblems carry their colours for the file managers that do not recolour them, and the "left out" one no longer has a gap where the bar meets the ring.
Fixed: a change in a folder while its preview was running could queue a normal sync behind it, on a folder that was waiting for a repair.

A new window, after the GNOME guidelines: the folders grouped by where they are, the overall status at the top, a page for each folder. Adding a folder suggests the matching folder on Koofr and lets you browse your Koofr folders or create one. The tray icon stays quiet when everything is up to date, turns blue while syncing, orange or red when something needs you, and its menu lists the files being transferred and the last ones synced. Fixed: Files showed no emblems after Spola restarted, and the Flatpak installed the Files extension where Files does not look.

The site and the repository page in English, sharper screenshots including Files, and a few fixes: a hidden marker file now tells a synced folder from an empty one in its place (ext4 reuses inode numbers), and the progress line says "1 file" instead of "1 files".
First development version: one or more folder pairs, two-way sync with previews and safety stops, tray icon.
